messages:
riley: Quick sync - planning OSS codelab + live benchmark webinar for next week. Need: launch post, short benchmark narrative (non-technical), webinar page copy with two headline options, and inbound lead routing into HubSpot. Who takes what?
sam: I9ll own the launch post + bench blurb. I9ll keep the bench simple: workload, models, p50/p95, and cost/1k tokens, plus a 30-40 word dev takeaway for socials.
anya: I can wire the form -> HubSpot + UTM params. Suggest utm_source=oss_codelab and utm_campaign=oss_launch_q3. I9ll add a role field to tag leads (engineer/product/other).
morgan: I9ll draft webinar page copy and two headline variants. Also propose a tiny chart caption: "p95 latency reduced ~30% vs baseline; cost per 1k tokens down ~35%" (placeholder until bench numbers land).
riley: Sam, try to phrase the benchmark for PMs and engineers both: one-sentence takeaway for product, one for devs. Anya, please make sure tracking pixel + test lead validation are done before publish.
sam: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/oss-codelab/pull/314 - includes post, bench table, and short tweet-ready blurb. Will add plain-language product takeaway.
anya: Routing stub: HubSpot form id 5542. Role-to-tag logic: ```if (role === "engineer") tag = "eng-lead"; else if (role === "product") tag = "pm-lead"; else tag = "other";``` Will add UTMs and test.
morgan: Headline A: "Hands-on: build a low-latency chat refapp with Redwood" Headline B: "Ship a production chat app: OSS codelab + live benchmarks" Leaning A for clarity. CTA: "Register to follow the build + live benchmarks."
riley: Two quick asks: 1) Sam - one-sentence PM takeaway and one 35-word dev tweet. 2) Anya - post screenshot of test lead in thread.
sam: PM takeaway: "See how a small config change and model quantization cut latency and cost without sacrificing response quality." Dev tweet (35w): "Build a low-latency chat app in one session. We share the code, configs, and live benchmarks so you can reproduce p95 wins on open models with Redwood. Join the live codelab: [link]"
anya: Tracking live. Test lead received in HubSpot - screenshot attached in the PR comments. Pixel fires OK.
devops-bot: Reminder - staging deploy scheduled for 2025-09-10T15:00:00Z.
riley: Target publish Tues morning so we can send the email Wed. Sam, lock copy by EOD. Morgan, pick primary headline. Anya, confirm final lead mapping.
morgan: Primary headline locked to A. Alt in PR.
sam: Final copy pushed and PR tagged for review.
anya: Confirmed - leads map and flows trigger role tags. All QA checks passed.
riley: Great work team - proceed to schedule emails. Checklist in PR. :rocket:
